questions.prompt: The Hundred Years' War was fought between England and which country?
questions.fact: It ran on and off for 116 years, and the name was applied only long afterwards by historians.

questions.prompt: What is the freezing point of water in Fahrenheit?
questions.fact: Fahrenheit set zero at the coldest temperature he could reliably reproduce with a salt-and-ice mixture, which is why water freezes at an odd number.

questions.prompt: Which race takes place annually at Le Mans?
questions.fact: Teams of drivers rotate through day and night, and the cars cover more distance in one race than a Formula 1 season.

questions.prompt: Which artist painted the Campbell's Soup Cans?
questions.fact: There are 32 canvases, one for each variety the company sold at the time, and they were first shown on shelves like a grocery aisle.

questions.prompt: Which country has the most people living below sea level?
questions.fact: About a quarter of the country sits below sea level, protected by dikes and a storm barrier built after the 1953 flood.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set in a future where firemen burn books?
questions.fact: The title is the temperature at which Bradbury was told paper ignites.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Swift programming language?
questions.fact: It was announced in 2014 to replace Objective-C, and made open source the following year.
